notes.title: Conclusion of Goodfoods collab
notes.content: The month long promotional collaboration with Goodfoods in celebration of Zero Food Waste Day has come to a conclusion. This tiny update removes the "Richard" variant of the player raccoon and other tweaks that only Canadian players will notice.

notes.title: Compass Pointers Added
notes.content:
This is a feature that has been requested many times for a very long time! I've added little pointers to the minimap compass that will point you toward nemesis challenges and the garbage trucks.

The mouse input for the camera has been reenabled by default.

notes.title: Fixed Wrong Boxes in Canada
notes.content: Oops! Players in Canada were getting the generic boxes, not the special promo boxes with the Goodfood promos inside.

notes.title: No Food Waste Day game update!
notes.content:
Today is No Food Waste Day, a great day to introduce a new gaming mechanic: [b]stealing food delivery boxes[/b]! That’s right, our raccoon is becoming a porch pirate! In front of some homes, you’ll find cardboard boxes (carelessly not yet brought in by the humans) that are a little tough to open (try swatting at them a few times). Inside, you'll find delicious fresh food. As for the trash bin in front of the same house? Well, they won't have any food inside because there was no food waste. 

This addition to the game was inspired by a collaboration with Goodfood, a Canadian meal kit service whose mascot is Richard the Raccoon. Richard is a grumpy raccoon who doesn’t like Goodfood, because their meal kits are perfectly proportioned - so there’s no food waste. 

For the next month, if you're playing in Canada, you'll play as Richard, and the boxes are Goodfood branded boxes. Players in Canada can find a special item inside - one that will give an actual IRL promo code valued at $250CAD!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410082/c0b3e94d1b51fb6d851d2b438cc999a2cbdaba60.jpg[/img]

Over the coming weeks I’ll be adding new boxes to be found in front of homes and the ability to pick up boxes and carry them away earning points for each theft. The pickup/carry mechanic is still a little buggy, so I won’t be introducing this until it’s functioning as intended.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410082/f335ca873d9069bc666fee3693a9cbaf60ab70cf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Promo Patch
notes.content: Quick fix: special promo item wasn't spawning frequently enough.

notes.title: Trash Panda partnering with Goodfood in Canada!
notes.content:
To celebrate in No Food Waste Day today, Trash Panda has partnered with Goodfood in Canada. Their company mascot is Richard, a hungry anti-hero raccoon does not like the fact that Goodfood meal kits come perfectly proportioned, so there's no food waste. 

This month, if you're playing in Canada, you'll play as Richard, and you have the option of stealing meal kits left in front of many houses (and carelessly not yet brought in by the humans!). As for the trash bins in front of houses with Goodfood boxes? Well, they won't have any food inside because there was no food waste. If manage to open the cardboard boxes (try hitting them around several times), you may find a special item inside - that will give an actual promo code valued at $250CAD!

In a few days, I'll upload another update for Trash Panda for players around the world to enjoy the new meal kit play mechanic too.

notes.title: Improved Camera Control
notes.content: I've never been totally happy with the way the camera controller works. So, I've been tinkering with a new version of the camera that won't go below the ground. Let me know what you think!

notes.title: Welcome to Morningside Heights
notes.content:
It took me longer than I expected, but at long last, a new neighbourhood has been added! “Morningside Heights” is the largest level in the game, accounting for roughly 2750km². The neighbourhood is in the north-east end of Toronto, in Scarborough. It happens to be next to the Toronto Zoo, so keep your eyes open for animals some “Canadian Domain” creatures! 

No one has played this new level other than me, so there’s a very good chance I missed a few issues. That’s why I’m releasing it with the disclaimer that it’s still in beta. Please let me know if you find any issues (screen captures or video recordings are very helpful!)

Also in this new build, I’ve fixed a few bugs involving the coyote barrier guards, the nemesis challenges, and the garbage collection.

notes.title: Minor improvements
notes.content:
Happy 2024! In this first update of the year, we have a bunch of small improvements and bug fixes.

These include:
- fixed the issue of the mouse cursor stealing control of the UI, even if the player isn't using the mouse as their input
- fixed the bug when super-speed powerup is happening, pressing the 'stand up' button prematurely ended the rolling speed 
- shortened the duration of the dreamy flying powerup (there were complaints it went on too long)
- eating edible trash during the challenge against the nemesis raccoon is now disabled during the challenge
- general improvements to The Beaches neighbourhood

Next update will include a new neighbourhood. I'm leaning towards Richview (suggested by a player via Discord), but I'm not 100% sure. Other candidates: Jane & Finch, Agincourt, Morningside Heights (next door to the Toronto Zoo).

Your suggestions/feedback will be appreciated. You can reach me on the game's Discord, or via Instagram/Twitter @HeyBishop.

Cheers,
   Jason Leaver
   creator/developer

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
With build 231205.2323, the major changes were cosmetic to The Beach(es) neighbourhood. I improved the terrans a touch (fixing landscapes that were connecting smoothly), and improved the boardwalk (which I thought was a little wonky), and changed the shoreline at the R.C. Harris Water Treatment Plant to be more accurate to real life. 

I also removed three trash bins from Cabbgetown, because the were out of reach to the player - thus never allowing you to get the achievement "No Bins Standing In Cabbagetown".

I tinkered with how the mouse cursor operates when menus are activated. Sometimes the mouse cursor will steal focus of a UI button even if you're not using it. I think I improved it a bit, but it's still not right.

notes.title: Trash Panda Launch Party!
notes.content:
Thrilled to announce the launch of my first video game on Steam, Trash Panda! It is finally ready to share with the world.

If you're in Toronto, you're welcome to join us IRL at the Transmedia Zone at Toronto Metro University TONIGHT (it happens to be the developer's birthday!), play the game, mingle, have refreshments and snacks.

Admission is free, but please get your e-tickets at:
https://buytickets.at/jleaverpresentations/1056439

Can't join in person? Follow #TrashPandaGame online!

notes.title: Games from Ontario Steam Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41410082/353d684dc22c7f289c6989aede7aaece00103666.png[/img]

You are invited to join Trash Panda's solo developer Jason Leaver, as he introduces his game set in his hometown of Toronto, Ontario, Canada. He'll share the game's origins (hint: it was garbage night), it's journey into fame (it kinda went viral in May 2021), why it is set in Toronto, why Torontonians are obsessed with raccoons, and maybe he'll get into the unexpected challenges of making a video game as a team of one.
